description: An extravagant purple-and-gold circular gadget ship with a mint glass canopy, tiny merchant pilot, brass pincer and slowly turning saw.
name: Merchant
notes: Portrait is translated to a circular top-down saucer; no oval front face or side-facing cockpit.
Eight distinct idle poses coordinate subtle hull breathing, pincer flex, turning saw teeth and crystal glints. No attack or gameplay effect is implied.
The pilot is seen only from the crown through the canopy. All colors and glass highlights are opaque pixel clusters with transparent background.
114 pixels equals six 19-pixel cells; pivot remains 57,57 and each direction is an exact ninety-degree rotation.
